stories.title: Utah lawmakers unveil draft legislation aimed at regulating police use of surveillance technology
stories.summary: Lawmakers unveiled draft legislation Wednesday that would impose new transparency requirements on law enforcement that uses automatic license plate reader systems.

stories.title: Promise that started at age 11 grows into Thanksgiving meals for 3,600 Utah families
stories.summary: What began as an 11-year-old boy's promise to his mother has grown into an annual effort expected to provide Thanksgiving meals to 3,600 families across Utah.

stories.title: Tooele County Council member charged with sex abuse
stories.summary: Tooele County Councilman Erik Stromberg is facing felony sex abuse charges based on incidents alleged to have occurred in 2023.

stories.title: The etiquette you're not thinking about: Healthy ways to talk about food this holiday season
stories.summary: Miki Eberhardt said there's another kind of holiday etiquette we don't always think about — how we talk about what we eat.

stories.title: Pearl Harbor survivor Gebhard 'Geb' Galle dies at 105, remembered for saving 4 shipmates
stories.summary: Gebhard "Geb" Galle, a Pearl Harbor survivor who saved four shipmates from a sinking vessel in a later battle, died at 105 on Saturday at his home in Moses Lake, Washington.

stories.title: Advisory issued for Utah's mountains after Wasatch Front receives first snow of season
stories.summary: Utah's latest storm produced big totals in the mountains and even some snow in the valleys, and there's more to come to close out the workweek.

stories.title: Dash camera footage shows Summit County deputies using PIT maneuver in chase
stories.summary: Newly obtained footage shows an attempted traffic stop for an unilluminated license plate that turned into a police chase, during which a Summit County Sheriff's Office deputy used a PIT maneuver to end the pursuit last December.

stories.title: Takeaways from Mullin's testimony on cyber outages, the Texas-LSU flight and immigration
stories.summary: At a House hearing Wednesday, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin addressed concerns about recent cyber outages across the United States. He said they were unrelated and not the result of cyberattacks.

stories.title: University of Utah bringing continuing education program to Asia campus
stories.summary: The University of Utah continuing education program is set to expand its reach globally through a new collaboration with the U.'s Asia Campus in Incheon, South Korea.

stories.title: '3 years cannot fix a lifetime of hurt': Shari Franke opposes parole for mother, Jodi Hildebrandt
stories.summary: Shari Franke opposes parole for her mother, Ruby Franke, and Jodi Hildebrandt, who were convicted of child abuse. She says neither woman has shown enough change or accountability and urges officials to deny parole next month.

stories.title: Have You Seen This? Caterpillars love silly noises
stories.summary: We don't seem to know much about caterpillars. But this video reveals some important insights.

stories.title: Deportations are up and arrests of Utah immigrants are also on the rise, data shows
stories.summary: Deportations across the country surged to the highest level ever in fiscal year 2026 while arrests of immigrants in Utah continue to rise, new data shows.
